integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] One uninterrupted TEN-SECOND cinematic LIVE-ACTION shot. TWO exact adult human fighters in the SAME warm dry canyon. Start EXACTLY from the supplied approved GOKU preparation image, red Kaioken active, both cupped hands with small blue core at his right rear hip. The original <Picture 1> fixes both human identities and costumes. <Picture 2> fixes the SAME VEGETA actor, his original white/ochre armor and bent-arm Galick Gun preparation beside his head. These are identity/technique references, not a montage or two different places.

CORRECTION AND SPATIAL STAGING: The audience MUST SEE VEGETA BEFORE HIS VIOLET ENERGY IS FIRED. Goku is at LEFT facing RIGHT; Vegeta is at RIGHT facing LEFT about12meters away, BOTH on the same visible level ochre ground plane with an OPEN EMPTY FIGHTING LANE between them. The cliff wall is BEHIND them, never between the palms and the opponent. All projected energy is visibly connected to the PALMS OF THE CORRECT HUMAN ACTOR. Nothing originates in mountain stone, the ground, an empty point or the frame edge. No purple ball or ray may appear until the clearly visible Vegeta thrusts his two palms. A huge purple blast from an unseen location is not allowed.

IDENTITY: Goku is the exact original taller athletic East Asian man with shaggy asymmetric BLACK hair/bangs and natural human face, orange heavy-cotton gi with original Turtle insignia, navy intact undershirt/sash/wristbands and original dark boots with red details; real skin, sweat and existing canyon dust. Kaioken is translucent CRIMSON around Goku only; Kamehameha BLUE-WHITE at Goku's hands only. Vegeta is the exact shorter compact adult from <Picture 2>, angular human face, widow peak/upright black hair, royal-blue bodysuit, white armor with ochre ribbed panels and raised shoulder/hip guards, white gloves and white/gold boots, original brown tail. His Galick Gun is VIOLET only. Keep these TWO people separate and anatomically intact. No additional fighters, recasting, blond hair, transformations, scouter, costume swaps, blood, new wounds or toy/cartoon skin.

0-2.5seconds REVEAL BEFORE ATTACK: Begin from Goku's approved wide grounded preparation. His blue core brightens between cupped hands at hip level; knees load against both supporting boots and he stares RIGHT toward Vegeta. Immediately the camera physically DOLLIES BACK and slightly RIGHT, widening the existing view to reveal the already-present Vegeta beyond the original right frame edge. Vegeta is visibly standing on the same ground at RIGHT, looking LEFT, both elbows bent and white-gloved hands gathered beside/above his RIGHT temple, violet charge cupped between them. Do NOT materialize him from smoke, rock or energy: the continuous widening reveals a real already-present human body with supporting boots and contact shadow. By about2seconds BOTH COMPLETE FIGHTERS and the EMPTY GROUND CORRIDOR between them are in frame. Neither has fired. Keep both readable in the same shot for the rest of the scene.

2.5-4seconds VEGETA LAUNCH: Only AFTER Vegeta's body and both white gloves have been clearly shown, he pivots his hips toward Goku and drives both bent arms from beside his head FORWARD toward LEFT. A single thick VIOLET GALICK GUN erupts from BETWEEN HIS TWO VISIBLY EXTENDED PALMS, the bright base continuously touching both gloves. Show the causal order: his leg/hip drive and two-palm thrust, violet mass at the palms, then its leading front traveling LEFT through the open lane. This is a dense shoulder-width violet column with white-hot inner core and rolling purple sheath, not a needle, flashlight or unrelated flying dot. Keep Vegeta and the entire connection from his palms to the advancing head visible. He resists recoil through grounded bent knees; no flying or sliding through rock. The lane ahead of the advancing front remains open.

4-6seconds GOKU COUNTER: Goku sees the visibly launched Galick Gun traveling toward him. He presses his rear boot into earth, turns his loaded hips/torso and brings BOTH cupped hands from his right hip FORWARD toward RIGHT in one decisive KAMEHAMEHA thrust. Blue-white energy erupts from BOTH PALMS, attached continuously to his two bare hands, traveling RIGHT toward the approaching purple front. A dense torso-width blue-white column with turbulent edges; no red beam, wrist laser, detached orb or energy from his chest. His crimson Kaioken continues around his human body. Both boots grip the earth, his rear leg drives and shoulders resist the recoil; cloth and dust respond after launch. Keep the exact actor and BLACK shaggy hair, no new stylized face.

6-10seconds TRACK THE TWO FRONT EDGES: BOTH fighters stay at opposite ends of the SAME SHOT. The blue beam is visibly fed by GOKU'S TWO PALMS at LEFT and the violet beam by VEGETA'S TWO PALMS at RIGHT. Their distinct leading fronts travel toward the central empty corridor. No beam emerges from a cliff, passes through a mountain, changes owner, branches into a third ray, teleports to center or appears disconnected from its actor. Maintain the readable continuous line Goku hands -> BLUE column -> open gap -> VIOLET column -> Vegeta hands. Near the END, the two fronts physically MEET ONCE at the center, several body lengths clear of either fighter: blue from LEFT against violet from RIGHT, bright compressed contact, turbulent colored rims and a single expanding low pressure ring that pushes grit outward across the floor. BOTH HUMAN SOURCES must remain visible at the ends when their energies meet. End on this first meeting, without winner, explosion swallowing the frame, aftermath or resolution.

CAMERA: one motivated widening/reframing during the initial reveal, then a restrained broad three-quarter SIDE VIEW of the entire duel corridor. Never cut, orbit, cross the axis, hide either source behind an energy flare or move close enough to lose Vegeta. Keep enough head/boot margin, realistic shared scale and a continuous visible floor. The cliff stays a BACKDROP. Real daylight on skin/cloth/armor with blue/purple reflected light that does not erase the human actors. Real-time action; red aura, rippling cloth, turbulent plasma and independent grit continue through the last frame. No slow motion, retiming, freeze, transition or held empty scenery.

overall_soundscape: Canyon air, grit/boots/cloth, increasing low charge pressure. One heavy violet launch synchronized to Vegeta's visible two-palm thrust, then one blue launch synchronized to Goku's visible two-palm thrust. Rushing opposed plasma and one low collision pulse when the two leading fronts touch. Sound effects only, no words, dialogue, voices, yells, grunts, cries, screams, singing or music.
non_diegetic_music: None.
